sloka: इतो द्वीपे समुद्रस्य संपूर्णे शत योजने ।तस्मिन् लंका पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-५८-२०॥
transliteration: ito dvīpe samudrasya saṁpūrṇe śata yojane ।tasmin laṁkā purī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā ॥4-58-20॥

translations.english: 'The beautiful city of Lanka is an island, a hundred yojanas away from here.It was built by Visvakarma.
